title: Geotechnical Engineer

Huadian Heavy Industries Co., Ltd. (HHI) is a Chinese state-owned enterprise and a subsidiary of China Huadian Group, one of the world’s largest power producers and a Fortune Global 500 company. HHI is engaged in the integrated development of EPC contracting, equipment manufacturing, and project investment, with core business coverage spanning the power, mining, metallurgy, and construction sectors.

About the role:

This role plays a key part in ensuring ground stability and foundation integrity by applying geotechnical analysis, design, and site-based technical judgment. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, capable of working independently, and experienced in handling both design and on-site challenges in dynamic project environments.

What you'll be doing:

Responsible for slope stability analysis and the design and calculation of foundations (especially pile foundations) to ensure overall safety and technical compliance of the project.

Analyze and interpret soil and rock investigation data as the basis for geotechnical design, including simulation of critical conditions (e.g., floods, earthquakes) using software such as GeoStudio and Plaxis to identify potential risks.

Develop ground improvement solutions, slope protection systems, and pile foundation designs (bored piles, precast piles, CFG, etc.), including bearing capacity, stability, settlement calculations, and technical specifications.

Provide technical guidance and supervise geotechnical works on site, while addressing issues arising during construction.

Prepare comprehensive geotechnical reports (analysis, calculations, and drawings) and ensure all work complies with applicable standards, regulations, and geotechnical codes in Indonesia, including support for inspection and project handover.

What we're looking for:

Bachelor’s degree in Geotechnical, Civil, or Geological Engineering (Master’s degree and Indonesian professional certification preferred).

Minimum 3 years of experience as a Geotechnical Engineer, with hands-on expertise in slope stability analysis and pile foundation design, preferably in Indonesian projects and familiar with local geological conditions and construction practices.

Proficient in geotechnical software (GeoStudio/Slope W, Plaxis 2D/3D, Lpile) with a strong understanding of slope stability, pile design principles, and relevant calculation methods, able to independently perform simulations and technical calculations.

Capable of preparing design calculations, technical reports, and drawings, with strong analytical thinking, technical judgment, and problem-solving skills in addressing on-site geotechnical issues.

Proficiency in English is required; the ability to communicate in Mandarin is a significant plus.

Benefits:

⁠Competitive salary

title: Supply Chain Manager
job_description:
Role Overview

The Supply Chain Manager is responsible for leading and optimizing planning, inventory management, and warehouse operations in an Engineer-to-Order (ETO) manufacturing environment. 

This role ensures material availability aligned with engineering release and production schedules, while maintaining control over inventory, warehouse efficiency, and overall supply chain performance. This position does not include procurement responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

1. Planning & Scheduling Excellence

Lead end-to-end planning processes in an ETO environment, including Master Production Scheduling (MPS), Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and capacity planning. 

Ensure alignment between engineering release, material availability, and production readiness. 

Manage long lead-time materials and complex bill of materials (BOM).  

Provide visibility on critical path, constraints, and material bottlenecks.

2. Systems & Planning Tools Governance

Own and optimize planning systems, including SAP (MRP, PP, MM).

Utilize advanced planning tools such as Microsoft Project, Primavera, Trello, or similar platforms.

Ensure accuracy of master data, including BOM, lead times, routings, and inventory parameters.

Drive digitalization and automation of planning processes.

3. Inventory Management & Working Capital

Define and implement inventory strategies aligned with ETO variability and project timelines.

Optimize inventory levels, safety stock policies, and material availability.

Balance service level and working capital targets.

Monitor and improve KPIs such as inventory turnover, stock accuracy, and excess and obsolete materials.

4. Warehouse & Internal Logistics

Lead warehouse operations ensuring efficient material flow, proper storage conditions, and full traceability.

Ensure high standards of inventory accuracy and material handling.

Optimize warehouse layout and internal logistics processes.

Implement digital tracking and control systems where applicable.

5. Cross-Functional Integration

Act as the key interface between Engineering, Production, Project Management, and Procurement (interface only).

Ensure coordination between design release and material readiness.

Support execution with clear visibility of material-related risks.

6. Performance Management & Continuous Improvement

Define and monitor KPIs such as material availability, planning adherence, and inventory performance.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and process optimization methodologies.

Promote standardization and discipline across planning and logistics processes.

7. Risk Management

Identify and manage risks related to material shortages, planning deviations, and inventory imbalances.

Develop mitigation plans and escalation routines to ensure continuity of operations.


﻿Qualifications

Experience 8 to 12+ years of experience in Supply Chain, with strong focus on planning, inventory management, and logistics.

Proven experience in Engineer-to-Order (ETO) or project-based manufacturing environments. 

Experience in transformers, heavy electrical equipment, or similar industries is highly preferred.

Technical Skills

Strong expertise in SAP (MRP, PP, MM) or equivalent ERP systems.

Experience with planning and scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project, Primavera, Trello, or similar platforms. 

Deep understanding of MRP, MPS, capacity planning, and complex BOM structures. 

Advanced analytical skills, including Excel and reporting tools. 

Leadership & Competencies

Strong leadership and ability to work across cross-functional teams.

High level of discipline in planning and execution.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to operate in complex, project-driven environments.

Fluency in English.

APICS certifications (CPIM or CSCP).

Experience with digital supply chain or planning transformation initiatives.

title: Senior IoT Integration Engineer
job_description:
We are seeking a Senior IoT Integration Engineer to design, deploy, and maintain wireless data acquisition systems in ATEX-classified hazardous areas. The primary project involves bridging RS485/Modbus field devices to desktop data readers using wireless technology, with intrinsic safety barriers at zone boundaries. This person will assess logger communication capability, integration options, data flow, security, cloud architecture, dashboard requirements, implementation risk, and rollout readiness. The output of this role is not only code, but also a practical and executable technical blueprint for the project. This scope matches the major layers used in industrial IoT solutions: field connectivity, interoperability, device authentication, telemetry ingestion, and dashboard/alerting




Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience in IoT system integration, industrial automation, or instrumentation engineering

• At least 2 years of hands-on experience with LPWAN technologies (LoRa/LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, or Sigfox)

• Proven experience with RS485/Modbus RTU protocol in industrial environments

• Experience working in or with ATEX/IECEx classified environments (oil & gas, petrochemical, chemical, pharmaceutical, or similar)




Core skills to screen for:

Industrial protocols: MQTT, Modbus RTU/TCP, OPC UA, REST, WebSocket

Networking: TCP/IP, VPN, APN, routing basics, RS485, serial debugging

Cloud/backend: IoT platform design, brokers, ingestion, APIs, time-series storage

Security: TLS, certificates, IAM/RBAC, secrets handling

Architecture: solution design, tradeoff analysis, documentation

Execution: feasibility study, scope definition, risk assessment, budgeting support

Communication: vendor coordination, stakeholder presentation, technical writing




Success criteria for the first 60–90 days

Complete assessment of current logger/device capability.

Deliver recommended end-to-end architecture.

Deliver integration decision: direct, gateway-based, or middleware-based.

Produce risk register and list of technical dependencies.

Produce implementation roadmap, estimated effort, and recommended team structure.

Identify whether firmware, gateway, backend, or dashboard customization is required

Analisis dan Solusi Masalah: Menggunakan MTBF, MTTR, dan FMEA untuk menganalisis masalah kinerja peralatan dan mengembangkan solusi berbasis data.

Standarisasi dan Penggunaan Data: Menyusun standar operasional untuk peralatan di seluruh outlet dan menggunakan data performa untuk merencanakan pemeliharaan guna memastikan performa konsisten.

Pengalaman:

Pengalaman 1 - 3 tahun di bidang pemeliharaan peralatan atau manajemen performa peralatan di industri F&B atau sektor multi-outlet.

Pengalaman dalam pengelolaan peralatan teknis seperti mesin espresso, grinders, HVAC, dan sistem terkait untuk memastikan kinerja peralatan yang optimal.

Keahlian dan Kompetensi:

Penguasaan metodologi analisis performa peralatan, termasuk MTBF, MTTR, dan FMEA untuk mengidentifikasi dan mengatasi masalah kinerja peralatan.

Kemampuan dalam pengelolaan TCO dan biaya terkait performa peralatan, guna mengoptimalkan investasi dan pemeliharaan.

Kemampuan untuk menggunakan data performa dalam pengambilan keputusan untuk meningkatkan efisiensi operasional dan memastikan kestabilan peralatan di seluruh outlet.

Keterampilan Tambahan:

Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun tim.

Keterampilan problem-solving yang kuat untuk menghadapi tantangan peralatan secara efisien dan tepat waktu.

Kenapa Bergabung dengan ARAH Coffee?

Membangun Sistem yang Berdampak: Anda akan merancang dan mengelola sistem pemeliharaan peralatan yang memberikan dampak langsung pada operasional dan pengalaman pelanggan di seluruh outlet.

Peluang Pengembangan Karir: Bergabung dengan perusahaan yang terus berkembang, di mana keahlian teknis Anda akan berkembang seiring dengan ekspansi bisnis.

Lingkungan Profesional: Kami menghargai pengambilan keputusan berbasis data dan memberikan ruang untuk inovasi dalam sistem yang efisien dan terukur.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan:

Mengawasi dan mengendalikan seluruh proses penerimaan (receiving), penyimpanan (put-away), dan pengeluaran (issuing) sparepart sesuai dengan SOP dan instruksi kerja yang berlaku.

Memastikan sistem First-In First-Out (FIFO) atau First-Expired First-Out (FEFO) berjalan secara konsisten untuk menghindari kedaluwarsa atau kerusakan teknis pada sparepart.

Menjamin ketepatan distribusi barang ke lini produksi atau departemen maintenance tepat waktu (just-in-time).

Bertanggung jawab penuh terhadap kecocokan data antara fisik di gudang dengan sistem (ERP/SAP).

​Memantau level stok minimum (buffer stock) dan titik pemesanan kembali (re-order point) untuk mencegah terjadinya stock-out yang dapat menghambat produksi

Menerapkan dan mengawasi implementasi budaya 5R di seluruh area gudang sparepart.

​Memastikan seluruh alat angkut (Forklift, Reach Truck, Hand Pallet) dalam kondisi layak pakai dan operator bekerja sesuai prosedur keselamatan.​

Mengatur tata letak (layout) gudang secara ergonomis untuk optimalisasi ruang simpan dan kecepatan akses pengambilan barang.

Menyusun jadwal kerja, pembagian tugas, dan penilaian kinerja (KPI) bawahan secara berkala.

Memberikan pelatihan teknis terkait prosedur gudang dan penggunaan sistem kepada anggota tim untuk meningkatkan produktivitas.

​Menyusun laporan performa gudang (Akurasi stok, Lead time penerimaan, Inventory turnover).

Mengelola barang lambat laku (slow moving) dan barang mati (dead stock) serta memberikan rekomendasi penghapusan stok (write-off) kepada manajemen.

​Menangani administrasi retur barang, baik dari internal maupun kembali ke supplier sesuai prosedur klaim yang berlaku.

Terbiasa bekerja dengan standar audit internal maupun eksternal (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, atau IATF 16949 untuk otomotif).

Mampu menangani kendala teknis pada sistem ERP atau ketidaksesuaian pengiriman dari vendor.

Pendidikan min. S1 Teknik Industri, Teknik Mesin, Manajemen Logistik dan bidang lainnya yang terkait.

Integration & Cloud Infrastructure : Design data integration across platforms (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.); Experienced in working with Cloud Platforms such as GCP, AWS, and Azure; Implement CDC pipelines and real-time synchronization across data systems.

Leadership & Collaboration : Provide technical direction to DBA, Data Engineer, and Developer teams; Collaborate with application and infrastructure architecture teams to design end-to-end systems; Develop database architecture documentation and best practice guidelines.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.

Minimum 8+ years of experience in database design, development, and administration.

Proven experience in architecting large-scale and high-performance database systems (OLTP & OLAP).

Deep understanding of relational and non-relational databases, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis.

Understanding of cloud-based database services (GCP Cloud SQL/BigQuery, AWS RDS/Redshift, Azure SQL).

Proficiency in scripting and automation using SQL, Python, or Shell scripting.

Knowledge of data governance frameworks, data retention, and archival strategies.

Experience in implementing data encryption, access control, auditing, and compliance with standards such as GDPR, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS.

Ability to design scalable, fault-tolerant, and secure data architectures supporting microservices and analytics workloads.

Experience designing data replication and synchronization topologies across multiple systems.

Strong understanding of API-based data integration and event-driven architecture.

Excellent communication and documentation skills to define and maintain database architecture blueprints and best practices.

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. The GFin Analytics team serves as the intelligence engine driving data-informed decisions across our payments and financial services products. As part of the Payments Tech Family, we're instrumental in accelerating cashless payments across all Grab verticals.

We're looking for analytically rigorous data analysts who have embraced AI as a force multiplier. If you excel at experimentation and behavioral analysis while leveraging LLMs to work smarter, and if you think in terms of scalable solutions rather than one-off analyses, we want to talk to you.

Design, measure, and recommend A/B tests and multivariate experiments across the platform. Transform ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical frameworks and conduct deep dive analyses that yield clear insights, using LLMs to rapidly prototype analytical approaches and synthesize findings into compelling narratives.
Balance analytical rigor with technical complexity and explainability while considering real world business constraints, leveraging AI to generate multiple solution approaches and evaluate trade offs efficiently.

Qualifications

4 years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Science, in a Tech (FinTech or E-Commerce) company.
A minomum of Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Analytics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related fields.
Experience in SQL (Presto, Hive) and visualization tools with solid Python or R programming skills, demonstrating daily use of AI and LLMs to create code faster than traditional methods.
Experience using AI tools to increase personal productivity with prompt engineering skills for code generation, analysis, and documentation, and AI coding assistants already integrated into your workflow.
Experience with apply AI solutions versus traditional approaches, can identify high ROI automation opportunities, and stays current with LLM and GenAI advancements through rapid experimentation.

We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.

title: Quality Engineer
job_description:
Tanggung Jawab Utama

1. Perencanaan dan Persiapan Mutu (Pre-Construction)

Menyusun RMK (Rencana Mutu Kontrak): Membuat dokumen rencana mutu proyek (Project Quality Plan) yang mengacu pada Spesifikasi Umum Bina Marga

Pembuatan JMF & JMD: Bertanggung jawab penuh atas pembuatan Job Mix Design (JMD) dan Job Mix Formula (JMF) untuk aspal (AC-WC, AC-BC) dan beton.

Approval Material: Mengajukan persetujuan sumber material (Quarry) kepada Konsultan Pengawas dan Owner (Dinas PU/Balai). Mengingat di Jayapura, memastikan kualitas aggregate dari quarry lokal atau material didatangkan dari luar (misal: Palu/Sulawesi) sesuai spek sangat vital.

Kalibrasi Alat: Memastikan seluruh peralatan laboratorium dan peralatan batching plant atau AMP (Asphalt Mixing Plant) sudah terkalibrasi dan layak pakai.

2. Pengendalian Material Masuk (Incoming Material Control)

Inspeksi Bahan Baku: Melakukan pengecekan rutin terhadap material yang masuk ke stockpile (aspal cair, semen, agregat kasar/halus).

Uji Kualitas Rutin: Melakukan tes abrasi, kelekatan aspal, berat jenis, dan gradasi secara berkala untuk memastikan material dari quarry tetap konsisten.

3. Pengendalian Proses di Lapangan (Process Control)

Persetujuan Izin Kerja (Request for Work): Memverifikasi kesiapan lapangan sebelum pekerjaan dimulai (cek kebersihan, tack coat/prime coat, kesiapan alat).

Monitoring Suhu & Hamparan: Mengawasi suhu aspal saat di AMP, saat tiba di lokasi (dump truck), dan saat penghamparan (laying) agar sesuai JMF.

Pengawasan Pemadatan: Memastikan jumlah passing (lintasan) alat berat sesuai dengan trial section yang sudah disepakati.

Drainase & Bahu Jalan: Memastikan mutu beton untuk saluran drainase dan material timbunan bahu jalan sesuai spesifikasi.

4. Pengujian dan Laboratorium (Testing & Lab)

Manajemen Laboratorium: Memimpin teknisi lab dalam pelaksanaan tes harian.

Pengujian Lapangan: Mengawasi pelaksanaan Sand Cone Test (kepadatan tanah), Core Drill (ketebalan aspal), dan tes ekstraksi aspal (kadar aspal).

Trial Section: Memimpin pelaksanaan percobaan penghamparan (trial) sebelum pekerjaan utama dimulai.

5. Administrasi dan Pelaporan (Documentation)

Laporan Harian & Bulanan: Menyusun laporan Quality Control (QC) harian, mingguan, dan bulanan.

Back-Up Data Quality: Menyusun kelengkapan data kualitas (hasil tes lab, foto dokumentasi, request) sebagai syarat penagihan termin (MC - Monthly Certificate).

Penanganan NCR (Non-Conformance Report): Jika ada pekerjaan yang tidak lulus tes (misal: aspal kurang tebal atau beton retak), QE wajib menganalisis penyebabnya dan mengusulkan metode perbaikan (corrective action) kepada Project Manager.




Kualifikasi yang Dibutuhkan

Pendidikan: Minimal S1 Teknik Sipil, D3/D4 Sipil diperbolehkan jika memiliki pengalaman lapangan yang sangat kuat.

Sertifikasi Kompetensi (SKK/SKA): Wajib memiliki SKK (Sertifikat Kompetensi Kerja) Konstruksi yang masih aktif.

Jenjang: Minimal Ahli Muda (Jenjang 7) atau Ahli Madya (Jenjang 8).

Bidang: Teknik Jalan atau Ahli Material Jalan.

Pengalaman Minimal 3–5 tahun pengalaman kerja di posisi yang relevan (Quality Control/Quality Engineer).

Memiliki pengalaman spesifik pada proyek jalan aspal (Hotmix).

Diutamakan yang pernah menangani proyek Preservasi/Rehabilitasi Jalan

Mampu membuat dan menghitung Job Mix Formula (JMF) untuk aspal (AC-WC, AC-BC) dan beton.

Mampu mengoperasikan alat-alat laboratorium sipil dan memimpin teknisi lab.

Menguasai prosedur tes lapangan: Sand Cone (kepadatan tanah), Core Drill (ketebalan), Slump Test, ekstraksi aspal, dan Marshall Test.

Software: Mahir menggunakan Microsoft Excel (untuk laporan Back-Up Data Quantity & Quality) dan AutoCAD (untuk gambar kerja sederhana/sketsa titik kerusakan).

title: Quality Control Engineer
job_description:
A key responsibility of the QC Engineer is to maintain and oversee NDT compliance, including ensuring that NDT personnel qualifications meet required standards and that inspections such as visual testing and other NDT methods are conducted properly. The position also requires reviewing inspection records and maintaining proper documentation in the Master Control System, ensuring all quality reports, inspection records, and data books are accurate and issued in a timely manner.

Operationally, the QC Engineer supervises daily shop floor inspection activities, conducts project briefings with inspectors, and coordinates closely with production teams to ensure inspection requirements align with manufacturing schedules. The role also involves preparing and updating quality plans, Inspection Test Plans (ITP), and inspection notifications, as well as issuing test requests and coordinating testing activities with vendors and third-party service providers.

The QC Engineer plays a critical role in identifying and managing nonconformities (NCRs) by initiating reports, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing corrective and improvement actions to prevent recurrence. The role also requires regular communication and coordination with customers, third-party inspectors (TPI), and vendors during inspection and surveillance activities, ensuring transparency and prompt response to customer complaints or quality issues.

In addition, the QC Engineer is responsible for monitoring inspection results, reviewing NDT findings, verifying calibration of inspection tools and equipment, and ensuring the validity of inspection data. The role includes preparing weekly reports on QC activities for the QHSE Manager, as well as generating monthly statistics on welder performance. The QC Engineer may also be required to plan QC resources for weekend work to meet production and customer requirements.

From a governance and compliance perspective, the QC Engineer ensures adherence to Oil States Industries’ HSE policies and Quality Management System, participates in internal and external vendor audits, and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening quality control processes.

The position requires a bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent, along with professional certifications such as AWS or CSWIP Welding Inspector and ASNT NDT Level II or equivalent. Strong technical knowledge of relevant standards—including API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 1104, API STD 64, NACE MR0175, ASME Section VIII and IX, and ASTM NDT standards—is essential.

Candidates are expected to have a minimum of seven years of experience as a QC Engineer, including at least four years in the manufacturing, repair, or remanufacturing of drilling equipment and tubular products, as well as experience supervising inspection teams, training personnel, and participating in quality audits. Strong communication, leadership, teamwork, and presentation skills, along with the ability to effectively manage quality-related issues with internal and external stakeholders, are critical for success in this role.

title: Data Engineer
job_description:
Requirement for Middle Level:

1. Min experiences 3-5 years as Data Engineer (Junior,Middle, Senior Level)
2. Experience in writing SQL query, SQL function and SQL procedure is mandatory
3. Experience in develop Microsoft Power BI Dashboard is mandatory
4. Have experience in SSRS reporting,  Google Big Query, ETL & data pipeline is advantage.
5. Have knowledge and experience in data science with Phyton is advantage.

Requirement for Junior Level :

1. Programming and Scripting: Proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for pipeline development.
2. Database Management: Expertise in SQL and Gogle Big Query
3. Data Modeling: Ability to design schema and data models optimized for analytics.
4. Big Data Tools: Knowledge of platforms like Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, or Flink for processing large datasets.
Problem Solving: Analytical skills for troubleshooting pipeline issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring data integrity.

Core Responsibilities
1. Data Pipeline Development and Management
Data engineers create and manage the pipelines that extract data from various sources, transform it into usable formats, and load it into databases or data warehouses (ETL/ELT processes). They ensure that data flows reliably from source systems to reporting and analytics platforms.
2. Data Storage and Architecture
They design and maintain scalable and secure data storage solutions, such as relational databases, NoSQL databases, and cloud-based data warehouses. They establish schemas, indexing strategies, and storage models optimized for performance and analytics.
3. Data Quality and Governance
Data engineers enforce data quality standards, implement validation and cleansing processes, and monitor pipelines to detect and resolve inconsistencies. They also ensure compliance with data governance policies and standards, including privacy regulations.
4. Performance Optimization and Scalability
Optimizing database queries, improving pipeline performance, and planning for scalable infrastructure to manage growing datasets are key responsibilities. This includes tuning systems to handle large-scale batch and real-time processing efficiently.
5. Collaboration with Stakeholders
Data engineers work closely with data scientists, analysts, and business teams to understand their data requirements and provide reliable datasets for analysis, reporting, and machine learning applications.
6. Tooling and Automation
They leverage tools such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, Kafka, Airflow, and cloud services like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform to automate workflows and manage large-scale data processing.

Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, streaming infrastructure, and AI/ML data workflows that power data-driven products and enterprise AI solutions — ensuring reliable, timely, and high-quality data is available across the organization — so that AI Engineers, Product teams, and enterprise clients can make accurate, insight-driven decisions and deliver intelligent customer experiences through Kata's AI and voice platforms.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Statistics, or related field
Relevant certifications (GCP Professional Data Engineer, Databricks, Airflow/Astronomer, etc.) are a plus

Technical Skills :

Streaming: Apache Kafka — topic design, consumer groups, partitioning strategy, and real-time event processing
Batch Orchestration: Apache Airflow — DAG design, scheduling, dependency management, and failure handling
Distributed Processing: Apache Spark — batch and micro-batch transformations, DataFrame API, optimization
Data Warehousing: Google BigQuery (primary); Apache Hive for large-scale batch analytics
NoSQL / Wide-Column: Apache Cassandra — data modeling for high-write, time-series, and event-driven workloads
Languages: Python (required); SQL (required); Scala is a plus
Cloud: GCP — BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI Pipelines; Azure is a plus
Containerization: Docker; basic Kubernetes for deploying data services
CI/CD: GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent for pipeline deployment automation
Data Quality: Great Expectations, dbt tests, or custom validation frameworks
Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, or GCP Monitoring for pipeline observability; alerting on SLA breaches
Version Control: Git with feature branching and pull request workflow

Experience : 

Associate Level (1–2 years)

1–2 years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering with data focus, or a related technical role
Hands-on experience building or maintaining data pipelines in a production environment
Practical exposure to at least one streaming or batch processing technology (Kafka, Spark, or Airflow)
Familiarity with SQL and relational or columnar databases (BigQuery, PostgreSQL, Hive, or equivalent)
Exposure to cloud data services on GCP or Azure
Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams with sprint-based delivery


Mid Level (3–5 years)

3–5 years of professional experience in data engineering, with at least 2 years building and operating production-grade pipelines
Proven hands-on experience with Apache Kafka for real-time event streaming — including topic design, consumer group management, and at-least-once/exactly-once delivery patterns
Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining batch workflows using Apache Airflow and large-scale data transformations with Apache Spark
Experience working with BigQuery and/or Hive for large-scale analytics workloads, including query optimization and partitioning strategies

job_description:
TECHNICAL PRODUCT & DELIVERY LEAD
Full-stack Software Engineer Background

GeoScanning & Telecommunications Signal Analysis Platform  |  Advanced English Required

West Jakarta | Full time on site

The Role

We are seeking a Technical Product Manager to bridge the gap between technical project management and full stack engineering. You will manage the development flow and timelines and serve as the senior technical voice on facilitating architectural decisions for the ecosystem, overseeing backend, web frontend, mobile (Android)  development.  You will act as the bridge between the CTO's strategic vision and the engineering team's daily work - converting high-level direction into clear, buildable specifications that each team member can act on without guesswork.

 This role requires advanced spoken and written English.

 Company Description

Pillar Technology is a provider of advanced communications solutions and a trusted supplier of telecommunications equipment to government and law enforcement agencies across Indonesia.

We are developing a web and Android platform for geoscanning of telecommunications signals — continuously collecting RF and GPS data in the field, uploading it to a backend server, and presenting operators with live signal visualisation, parameter analysis, and identification of areas of interest. The team currently comprises five engineers: backend, frontend, UI/UX, and two Android developers, working toward a production-ready release.

Qualifications

Essential

· 5+ years in Software Engineering, technical project management with a strong foundation in full stack development, or a closely related software role.

· Deep understanding of Backend (API Design/ DB management), web (modern frameworks like React) and mobile (Native or Cross-platform)

· Proven ability to write precise, unambiguous feature specifications that developers can build from independently.

· Working knowledge of software concepts — APIs, databases, frontend/backend architecture, mobile development — sufficient to hold a technical discussion and spot spec gaps.

· Hands-on agile experience: sprint planning, backlog management, and running ceremonies for a small team.

· Experience owning a QA or acceptance testing process — writing test cases, logging bugs, and making release decisions.

· Disciplined approach to documentation — feature specs, release notes, service records, and configuration logs maintained consistently throughout the project lifecycle.

· Advanced written and spoken English — specifications are the foundation of the team's daily work (please do not apply if this requirement is not met).

Nice to Have

·       Degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related technical field — preferably from a top-tier Indonesian university (ITB, UI, ITS Surabaya, Telkom University, BINUS).

·       Background in or exposure to telecommunications, RF systems, GPS data, or geospatial platforms.

·       Familiarity with Figma or wireframing tools; exposure to SQL or data analysis.

·       Experience managing requirements for Android apps involving background services or data collection.

Key Responsibilities

Project Orchestration

· Manage the end-to-end project lifecycle, defining milestones and ensuring timely delivery.

Architectural decision making:

· Select and validate the tech stack decisions across BE, FE and Mobile. Ensure architecture is scalable, secure and maintainable.

· Define technical contracts (APIs / Databases) that allow our different platforms to communicate.

· Conduct high level code review and set engineering standards.

Feature Specification

· Write detailed PRDs defining feature behaviour in full: happy path, edge cases, error states, and explicit logic rules.

· Establish a Definition of Ready — every sprint item must have complete acceptance criteria before development begins.

· Collaborate with the UI/UX designer to validate wireframes against requirements before build starts.

Sprint & Delivery Management

· Own the prioritised product backlog and run full agile ceremonies across all five engineering streams.

· Manage the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) from requirements through release and post-release monitoring — ensuring each phase has clear ownership and handoff criteria.

· Track sprint delivery, surface blockers early, and manage cross-stream dependencies between backend, frontend, and Android.

· Own the release calendar, define delivery Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with the CTO, and report regularly against them.

QA & Release Sign-Off

· Own the QA process across the team — there is no dedicated QA engineer; this role fills that function.

· Conduct functional acceptance testing against the acceptance criteria you defined, before any feature is released.

· Log, prioritise, and track bugs discovered during testing back into the product backlog.

· Plan and coordinate structured User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with the CTO and end-client stakeholders; document outcomes and ensure sign-off before production releases.

· Make the go/no-go call on each release — you are the final quality gate before a build ships.

Technical Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication

· Work with engineers to understand how functional requirements affect the system — APIs, data flows, background service behaviour, upload reliability — without writing production code.

· Identify when a seemingly simple functional change carries significant engineering cost.

· Act as the first point of escalation (L2) for operational issues reported by end-clients — triage, document, and route to the appropriate engineer.

· Maintain comprehensive documentation across the full product lifecycle: system configurations, feature specs, release notes, and service records.

· Translate CTO direction into precise developer language; translate engineering constraints into clear CTO updates.

· Produce concise sprint summaries, milestone updates, and risk assessments.

What We Offer

·       Competitive full-time compensation commensurate with experience.

·       A technically complex, mission-critical platform deployed by government and law enforcement clients.

·       High-visibility role with direct access to the CTO — your judgement will be trusted and acted upon.

·       Potential for long-term involvement as the platform scales toward full production deployment.

We design and operate critical platform components such as the Loan Management System, Repayments Engine, and Product Flow Orchestrator—powering seamless and reliable lending experiences at scale. You will design, build, and operate backend services that power end‑to‑end lending journeys – from origination and decisioning to servicing and repayments – across multiple markets.

You will work closely with product managers, designers, data and Ops teams to deliver high‑quality features, drive operational excellence, and mentor other engineers. This role is based in Indonesia with close collaboration across distributed teams in Asia.

Design and implement backend services that are robust, scalable, observable, and cost‑efficient, primarily in Golang and running on our Kubernetes‑based platform.
Own end‑to‑end delivery of features and projects: requirements clarification, design, implementation, testing, rollout, and post‑launch monitoring.

Support hiring by participating in interviews and helping improve our question banks, guidelines, and job descriptions.

5+ years of backend engineering experience in a distributed systems environment, with experience with shipping and operating production services at scale.
Computer science fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and design of large‑scale systems.
Solid experience with at least one modern backend language (e.g. Golang, Java, C++, C#, Python) and a willingness to work with Golang.
Hands‑on experience with relational databases (e.g. MySQL/PostgreSQL) and familiarity with NoSQL/streaming technologies (e.g. Kafka, DynamoDB, Redis) or equivalents.
Experience building and operating REST/gRPC services in a microservices or service‑oriented architecture on a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Demonstrated experience for end‑to‑end delivery, including production quality, performance, and reliability.

We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.

title: Senior Welding Engineer
job_description:
About us

With a strong track record of supporting customer success for over 75 years, Oil States Industries is a technology-focused and major global provider of integrated energy systems & solutions to oil and natural gas markets. At Oil States Industries, we cultivate a culture that recognizes our employees are our greatest asset. Together, we focus on innovation, teamwork, and our commitments to our customers. We now have an exciting career opportunity for an aspiring individual to make an impact, develop your capabilities and unleash your potential with Oil State Industries as a Senior Welding Engineer. This position will be based in Batam, Indonesia.

Job Description

Prepare, maintain/update Welding Procedure Specification (WPS), Procedure Qualification Record (PQR), Welder qualification record and Welder performance record. Transition data into Weld Eye Software and lead its training and implementation.

Develop new Welding Procedure Specification(s), Welding Procedure Qualification Record, as required.

Establish and maintain procedures for production welding and welding personnel, to ensure compliance with specifications, processes, and heating requirements. Prepare and maintain Welding Procedure Specification Matrix and Welders Qualification matrix.

Develop or modify work instruction that convey the technical requirements (WPS, Consumable control etc.) of applicable International Standard to the Welders and Inspectors.

Identify material grade based on Positive Material Identification (PMI) reports. Work with Project team in the selection of appropriate welding process and WPS. Review route sheets.

Work with Welding Supervisor/ Charge hand / Senior Workshop Supervisor to ensure welding operations are carried out in a controlled manner so as to achieve and maintain acceptable weld quality. Lead the Production & Quality team towards the achievement of weld quality objectives.

Assist with issuing Post Weld Heat Treatment (PWHT) requests. Assist Production team with job planning (Eg. Fixtures, welding sequence). Assist Maintenance team on technical matters related to welding machines

Review weld inspection and NDE inspection results to ensure compliance with the welding procedures and standards. Provide disposition for welding related NCRs.

Conduct weld quality meetings to review welding performance. Lead to the correct root cause through discussions with Production & Quality teams and involve tools such as 5 WHY and Fish bone diagram.

Monitor welding performance and weld quality issues at Oil States and its approved vendor facilities, in the Asia Pacific & Middle East region. Trouble shoot welding related problems and provide solutions.

Conduct training for welders, welding operators on weld quality & welding safety as part of continual improvement.

Participate in vendor audits / qualification. Approve the Welding Procedure Specification of the Suppliers / Vendors.

Coordinate with Stores to maintain optimum stock levels for Welding consumables inventory, on the basis of requirements for ongoing jobs and annual budget.

Arrange for material testing and analysis. Review results and where applicable, investigate failures.

Pre-empt welding problems through the evaluation of new techniques, materials, new equipment requirements and training needs.

Conduct Research & Development investigations and analyse, improve/upgrade the existing welding, techniques and procedures, welding machines and accessories, as part of continual improvement.

Consult relevant OSI subsidiaries, agencies, customers etc, to exchange ideas, information and/or technical advice.

Prepare technical reports to showcase the results of Research & Development, enhancements to product quality and welding process, preventive maintenance.

In the absence of Senior Workshop Supervisor, coordinate Subsea welding work.

Perform all other reasonable duties as required by Manager.

Participate, as required, in Quality and EHS audits from API and other external organisations.

Requirements

Degree/Diploma in Engineering or equivalent

Minimum 3 years of experience as a Welding Engineer.

Proven track record as a Welding Engineer.

Minimum 3 years of experience working in a Manufacturing environment, preferably in the Oil & Gas Industry. 

Applied knowledge of welding activities for all types of steels including carbon steel, stainless steel, high and low alloy steel.

Knowledge of international codes such as API 1104, API 5L, API 6A, API 16A, API 16R, API 16C, ASME sect IX and AWS D1.1.

You’ll also be part of a friendly, supportive design team that’s keen to improve how we work and help each other grow.

With the support of your team, you will work with key partners across the business (from product, editorial, marketing, data and commercial teams) to design and optimise  experiences to drive both user satisfaction and business outcomes.

You will be involved in carrying out user research alongside your team to understand user behaviour and identify needs.

You will articulate key insights and translate them into testable artefacts like sketches, user flows or interactive prototypes that utilise The Economist brand to test assumptions and ideas.

You will define user flows and journeys, ensuring clarity and alignment across teams.

You will create production ready design assets and work with engineers to ensure a high quality experience is shipped.

title: Prompt Engineer
job_description:
APTAVIS membuka kesempatan bagi talenta kreatif dan analitis yang tertarik pada dunia Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLM), dan automasi untuk bergabung sebagai Prompt Engineer.


Tanggung Jawab Utama

1. Merancang, mengembangkan, dan mengoptimalkan prompt untuk berbagai kebutuhan (chatbot, voice bot, analisis data, AI agent, dsb).

2. Melakukan testing dan iterasi cepat untuk meningkatkan akurasi dan stabilitas output model.

3. Membuat prompt template, guidelines, SOP, dan best practices yang akan digunakan oleh internal tim.

4. Berkolaborasi dengan tim Product, Engineering, dan QA untuk integrasi prompt ke aplikasi, fungsi API, maupun agent workflow.

5. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Marketing & Creative untuk menghasilkan konten AI yang sesuai dengan brand tone dan kualitas yang diinginkan.

6. Menganalisis output model (error, halusinasi, bias, ketidakkonsistenan) dan memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan.

7. Mendokumentasikan seluruh prompt, konfigurasi, hasil pengujian, skenario penggunaan, dan limitasi model.

8. Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi AI/LLM terbaru (GPT, Gemini, Claude, Llama, agentic AI, automasi, dll).

9. Memberikan edukasi internal mengenai cara penggunaan AI yang efektif dan aman untuk tim dan klien.


Kualifikasi

1. Pendidikan minimal S1 (diutamakan Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Data Science, Linguistik, Komunikasi, atau bidang terkait).

2. Pengalaman merancang prompt LLM (GPT/Gemini/Claude/Llama) adalah nilai tambah besar.

3. Memiliki pemikiran kritis, analitis, dan logis dalam memecahkan masalah.

4. Menyukai eksperimen dan mampu melakukan iterasi prompt secara cepat dan terukur.

5. Memahami dasar-dasar AI/ML, NLP, atau arsitektur sistem (tidak harus mendalam, namun mampu memahami konsep).

6. Mampu menulis dengan jelas, terstruktur, dan komunikatif.

7. Terbiasa melakukan riset dan analisis untuk memahami perilaku model AI modern.

8. Memiliki kemampuan problem-solving, debugging prompt sederhana, dan memperbaiki respons AI.

9. Memiliki orientasi terhadap detail, kualitas output, dan konsistensi.


Nilai Tambah (Nice to Have)

* Berpengalaman menggunakan tools seperti OpenAI Playground, HuggingFace, LangSmith, Postman, RAG tools, atau agent frameworks.

* Memahami function calling, vector database, atau integrasi API.

* Familiar dengan pengujian AI: latensi, akurasi, grounding, hallucination checks.

* Portofolio eksperimen prompt (dokumen, GitHub, Notion, atau studi kasus).
